## Sync must never green-lie: per-file generation failures are now first-class… — 2026-07-25 (parent 568772984973)

Per-file generation failures are now first-class output rather than silent skips. `SchedulerResult` gains an `errors` list of `(rel_path, message)` tuples; exceptions in `_RunState._collect` append there instead of incrementing `skipped_other`. `IncrementalResult` and `BootstrapResult` thread the new `file_errors` field from the scheduler upward.

On the CLI side, new helper `_report_sync_errors` prints up to five failures, appends a credentials hint when error text implies a missing API key, and returns a boolean indicating whether any errors occurred. `_run_full_pass` and `_run_incremental_sync` call it and exit 1 on failure; incremental runs where every file failed emit "tree was NOT refreshed" before exiting. A new test `test_all_files_erroring_is_not_a_silent_success` asserts the regression case.

### Changes

- ~ trie/sync/scheduler:SchedulerResult — "Holds the outcome of a wave-based file sync run with results and skip counts." → "Holds the outcome of a wave-based file sync run with results, skip counts, and per-file errors."
- ~ trie/sync/scheduler:_RunState._collect — "Processes completed file sync future, updating _RunState results and checking budget/limit caps." → "Processes completed file sync future, updating `_RunState` results and checking budget/limit caps."
- ~ trie/sync/incremental:IncrementalResult — New file_errors field threaded from the scheduler.
- ~ trie/sync/bootstrap:BootstrapResult — New file_errors field threaded from the scheduler.
- + trie/cli:_report_sync_errors — "Report per-file sync failures to `reporter`, printing up to 5 errors plus a credential hint when error text suggests a missing API key."
- ~ trie/cli:_run_incremental_sync — Reports errors; all-failed runs exit 1 with 'tree was NOT refreshed'; partial failures exit 1 after the summary.
- ~ trie/cli:_run_full_pass — Bootstrap reports errors and exits 1 when any file failed.
- + tests/test_scheduler:test_all_files_erroring_is_not_a_silent_success — "Regression test asserting that all-file errors populate `errors`, not `skipped_other`, so callers cannot silently interpret a total failure as "nothing to do"."
- ~ trie/sync/scheduler:_RunState.__init__ — "Initializes _RunState with scheduler configuration and zeroed accumulator state for tracking sync results and costs." → "Initializes `_RunState` with scheduler configuration and zeroed accumulator state for tracking sync results, costs, and per-file errors."
